bible.title: The Quiet Siege
bible.kernel: A fort hires the company to fetch Alyva of the Ford from the Western Forests. The trail runs from a gate, to an archive, into a ruined shelter, and back to the fort, where the librarian who sheltered her blocks the handover.

cast.name: Alyva of the Ford
cast.who: a human leader who commanded the Ford garrison and fled after the siege. Now fevered and guarded by books

cast.name: Sirinaire Mosswalker
cast.who: an elven librarian of the Hollowstave Archive who shelters the sick and keeps fugitives from the law
cast.want: to keep Alyva safe inside the archive's care

bible.situation: The fort's garrison at the Ford surrendered after a short siege that ended without battle. Alyva slipped away with nothing more than a few books and a fever. The fort wants her brought back to answer charges. The company has the fort's task and the fort will receive Alyva at Crossbar Yard when she is returned.
bible.goal: Return Alyva of the Ford to Crossbar Yard at the fort.
arc: Ride to Thornford Gate the fort named and ask for news of Alyva of the Ford → yields: a scrap of lignum bark stamped with the Hollowstave librarian's neat mark
Take the librarian's scrap to the Hollowstave Archive and press it for audience at the long gate → yields: a carved pine log left by Sirinaire Mosswalker, burned with a map toward Mossmere
Follow the pine log's burned map into the Mossmere Ruin to find the shelter the log marks → yields: Alyva of the Ford, fevered and refusing to leave her hiding place
Carry Alyva back to Crossbar Yard the fort named and present her to the yard. Face Sirinaire when she arrives to block the handover and force, bribe, or outwit her at the yard to complete delivery
tensions: Alyva's fever weakens escorts and draws the fort's fear of contagion
The Hollowstave's laws and Sirinaire's oath forbid handing over those sheltered inside
Forest travel to the Mossmere Ruin is slow and the ruin's ruinous bridges threaten the injured
openDirections: Alyva's illness will either be treated and contained or it will force the fort to quarantine or burn the shelter, changing who will stand with or against her.
bible.stakeIfLost: If Alyva is not returned, the fort's supply pledge from the Western Houses will be revoked, cutting off the convoy that keeps the yard provisioned.
bible.arrival: sent word twice before coming · had rehearsed it

shipped.title: Ask at Thornford Gate
shipped.situation: A rider has arrived at Thornford Gate asking after Alyva of the Ford. If Alyva is not returned, the fort's supply pledge from the Western Houses will be revoked, cutting off the convoy that keeps the yard provisioned. The yard wants someone to learn whether Alyva is at Thornford Gate and to bring her back, so ride to Thornford Gate and ask for news of Alyva of the Ford, the pay is the agreed coin, and what the road turns up. A librarian means to keep Alyva safe inside the archive and may refuse any handover. Alyva sent word twice before coming and had rehearsed what to say.
shipped.job: Ride to Thornford Gate and ask for news of Alyva of the Ford
